renderLayerContract.generatorCoverage: Current stock generator builds primitive carriers and reads latheProfile. It does not establish implementation of renderIntent, named grids, per-submesh localOverrides or the whole renderLayerContract. Subsequent source work requires separate approval and visual evidence.

materialWiring.rule: A material declaration is not evidence that per-submesh scalar overrides, geometric paths, depthWrite or blend mode have been emitted; verify runtime before material-pass acceptance.

geometryScaleContract.reason: Generator scale_vector prioritizes transform.scale over dimensions. Omit component transform.scale so geometry receives the authored dimensions once; pivot nodes and factory root stay identity-scaled.
